test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Why is CBCS considered a step toward global academic standards?

options.text: It separates Indian education from international standards and practices.
It keeps only traditional subjects and does not focus on skill development, which makes education less competitive worldwide. This means students do not learn the skills needed for the future.
It does not accept reforms and uses old teaching methods that do not meet global standards. Because of this, students lose the chance to develop creative thinking skills.
It follows global models by giving students flexibility, interdisciplinary choices, and a credit-based system.

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 4: It follows global models by giving students flexibility, interdisciplinary choices, and a credit-based system.***

 
 
• The passage explicitly states that CBCS is **"Inspired by international educational models"** and is used to **"align with global standards."**
